_notes: Xhosa translations verified against: UNISA Learn Online Xhosa Theme 9 (body and wellness); Scribd Xhosa body parts and health phrases; Ndiphethwe construction from academic sources. Emotionally weighted strings flagged for human review.

today.desc_menstrual: Umzimba wakho uyakhulula. Ukuphumla, ubushushu, nokunyakaza kancinci kukuxhasa ngoku.
today.desc_follicular: Amandla ayanda. Ulusu lwakho lukhanyile, ingqondo yakho ibukhali. Ixesha elihle lokuceba nokwenza.
today.desc_ovulation: Ukhoyo ekuphakameni kwakho. Ukuzithemba kuphezulu, ulusu luyakhanya, nokunxibelelana kuza ngokwemvelo.
today.desc_luteal: Ukucothisa ngokuhlakanipha. Umzimba wakho ulungiselela. Hlonipha ukuphumla kwaye nciphisa ukukhuthaza.
today.desc_unknown: Rekhoda ixesha lakho lokuqala ukuvula ulwazi lomjikelo wakho.
today.cta_follicular: Kwiveki le ulusu lwakho lukhanyile kakhulu. Ixesha elihle lokubhuka ukususwa koboya okanye itreatment yobuso.
today.cta_ovulation: Ulusu lwakho luyakhanya ngoku. Yisebenzise kakuhle ngetreatment.

log.title: tara-s
log.body: Ubehlala azi umzimba wakhe. Le ndawo yeyakho ukukhumbula.

insights.title: Oko umzimba wakho ukuxelela.
insights.subtitle: Iinkqubo ezivela kwinto oyirekhodileyo.
insights.empty_title: Iinkqubo zakho ziya kubonakala apha njengoko urekhoda.
insights.need_more_data_body: Rekhoda umjikelo omnye kwakhona kwaye uTara uya kuqala ukubona umjikelo wakho.
insights.avg_duration: Ixesha lakho lihlala malunga ne-{days} iintsuku.
insights.variability_consistent: Imijikelo yakho ibilungile kakhulu kutsha nje.
insights.variability_regular: Imijikelo yakho ilungile ngokwaneleyo. Utshintsho oluncinci lulungile ngokupheleleyo.
insights.variability_irregular: Imijikelo yakho yokugqibela yahluka ngama-{days} iintsuku. Ingcindezi, uhambo, okanye ukugula kunokubangela oku.

privacy.title: Esibambele yona, kunye nesizathu.
privacy.subtitle: Oku ngokwakho. Konke.
privacy.section_collect_body: Iintsuku zakho. Iimpawu zakho. Akunye. Asifuni indawo yakho, abantu obaxhumana nabo, okanye imikhwa yakho ngaphandle kwesi app.
privacy.section_storage_body: Igcinwe ngokhuselo kwiiseva ze-EU. Ayabelwani. Ayathengiswa. Nakubani, nangaluphi na uzathu.
privacy.section_control_body: Thabatha konke nawe, okanye yiyeke ngokupheleleyo. Cofa kanye ukuze ulayishe konke. Cofa kanye ukucima konke, ngonaphakade.
privacy.delete_confirm: Oku kuya kucima konke ngonaphakade. Akuphindwa. Uqinisekile?

onboarding.date_q2_sub: Iintsuku ezibini zisinceda ukufumana umjikelo wakho.
onboarding.date_q3_sub: Iintsuku ezintathu size siqale ukubona ipateni yakho.
onboarding.ready_sub: tara-s iya kufunda kunye nawe. Okurekhodayo okuninzi, okuqondayo okuninzi.
